No test may get weaker: every mutant series that was red stays red; the T1-T4 mutants that touch these files are run again and counted.
Not to be done here: L1, L2 (ORCH, the owner's list) and L3 (CODE-FIXER).

issues.text: Scratch only: the folders <scratch>/w, <scratch>/m1 and <scratch>/m2 of earlier sessions in the shared working folder were deleted and made again as the clones of this step (rm -rf before git clone); nothing of the project was touched. The scripts of the T2, T3 and T4 mutants were still in the scratch folder and were run again; the scripts of the T1 mutants were not kept, so the T1 mutants of vercel-build.test.js and import-boundaries.test.js (series 3 and 4) were written again from the list of the T1 handoff, not replayed byte for byte.

Observation of the code, no test asks for a change: on /demo.html the heading holds the focus at load (demo.js:495, heading.focus), so the first Tab there goes to «‹ Назад» and the skip link is reachable only by Shift+Tab; on / it is the first stop. Evidence: a driver in Chrome, the local server: '/ active at load: BODY | after first Tab: A.skip'; '/demo.html active at load: H2 | after first Tab: BUTTON.btn ghost back'. The first form of the M2 row (the first Tab) was red on the code at /demo.html for exactly this; the row now takes the focus by a call, because its subject is where the link stands, not the tab order. Whether the first Tab of the demo should reach the skip link is a question for the design (the look 7.1 and the focus rule of the demo), not decided here.

The M1 rows are inside LD-5 (section E) and the M2 rows inside LD-1, so the count of e2e tests (15) and the ids of NPM-7 and E2E_TESTS stay as they are and the design's count in the guard needs no edit. LD-5's timeout is 600000 ms (was 240000: the new section adds about 30 s on this machine) and its title ends with ', the focus above the live strip'; the full e2e run is about 6.7 minutes (399.8 s and 398.8 s).

The M1 row reads the first scroll position too: at 320x568 «‹ Назад» is read when it is focused, and the finding L1 of the reviewer (the sliver under the strip without a focus, 12 of 15 states) is not asserted by any test, as O26 keeps it as an owner's decision (G21). If the owner moves «‹ Назад» (the rule of O26), a row for the unfocused position at 320x568 is the next test.
The handoffs-check line for handoffs/M0DOCS-20261117-01/step-05c-test-designer.json (PENDING in a commit) is the known one and not this step's.
